context:
Goal: a pricing list that shows only reasons that exist.
Problem (goal): you asked whether the slot can be filled. Only one source on main can fill it, and it describes the market rather than play.
Based on (measured): pricing lane check, 2026-11-02 18:36 CST. Main has no meta or deck data. The daily TCGCSV read (D325, a daily read builds market history) holds 5 days of Riftbound prices that nothing reads yet. It can back a set-wide line such as "Unleashed singles are down 9% in 5 days across all sellers": Riftbound live rows only, no new download, 2 database reads per page.
Based on (read): the price research found momentum does not predict singles prices, so the line must describe, never forecast.
Based on (ruling): your item 40 keeps the Riftbound card sort private, out of the repo. Using it here would change that ruling.
Mockup at 1440: https://github.com/shivinate7/banchi/blob/72a24bbc8/docs/design/pricing-suggest/list-1440-light.png (the Dusknoir row is the sample slot).

options.gain: The slot shows something real now, at no download cost.
options.how: A small lane reads the daily TCGCSV table and writes one describing line per set on Riftbound rows.
options.label: Fill it with a set-wide market line
options.lose: Riftbound only, and it says how the market moved, not why.

options.gain: Nothing weak on screen; the slot waits for a real play signal.
options.how: The builder draws no row until a play signal exists.
options.label: Keep the slot empty for now

options.gain: A real play signal for every Riftbound card.
options.how: The sort's groups (staple, meta-dependent and so on) enter the repo and feed the slot.
options.label: Fill it from the Riftbound card sort
options.lose: Changes your item 40 ruling: the sort would no longer be private.

options.gain: The design holds only what ships.
options.how: Remove it from the design; add it back with the first signal.
options.label: Drop the slot
options.lose: A redesign pass when a signal arrives.

ref: pricing-suggest spec section 4b (outside signal: a slot, not a trigger); list mockup notes, point 5
title: What should fill the outside-signal slot on the pricing list?
why: You asked to fill it, and this is the one source on main: cheap, honest about what it says, and easy to remove.
